item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-12 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. City Editing: Hierarchical Agentic Execution for Dependency-Aware Urban Geospatial Modification — 城市编辑：面向依赖感知城市地理空间修改的分层智能体执行 (92/100)
  2. An Autonomous GeoAI Agent for Arctic Eco-Navigation — 面向北极生态导航的自主GeoAI智能体 (85/100)
  3. Applying foundation model embeddings towards urban livability evaluation — 应用基础模型嵌入进行城市宜居性评估 (82/100)
  4. SPECTRA: Band-Routed Embedding and Stage-Wise LoRA for Cross-Sensor Fine-Tuning of Geospatial Foundation Models — SPECTRA：面向地理空间基础模型跨传感器微调的波段路由嵌入与阶段式LoRA (80/100)
  5. From Landslide Conditioning Factors to Satellite Embeddings: Evaluating the Utilisation of Google AlphaEarth for Landslide Susceptibility Mapping using Deep Learning — 从滑坡条件因子到卫星嵌入：评估利用Google AlphaEarth进行深度学习滑坡易发性制图 (78/100)
  6. Truncated Noisy Best-Response Algorithms: Toward Game Theoretic Learning with Safety Guarantees — 截断噪声最佳响应算法：迈向具有安全保证的博弈论学习 (75/100)
  7. PPO-STGNN: A Proximal Policy Optimization Approach with Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for DAG Task Scheduling in Cloud-Edge-End Computing — PPO-STGNN：一种结合近端策略优化与时空图神经网络的云边端DAG任务调度方法 (75/100)
  8. Evaluating Graph Neural Networks for Change-Criticality Classification in Maritime Navigation Charts — 评估图神经网络在航海图变化关键性分类中的应用 (75/100)
  9. Predicting Residential Rents in Dakar Using Machine Learning — 使用机器学习预测达喀尔住宅租金 (75/100)
  10. Season-Aware Hybrid Convolutional-Transformer for Antarctic Sea Ice Concentration Forecasting — 季节感知的混合卷积-Transformer用于南极海冰浓度预测 (75/100)
